integrity: Mathematical proof is self-contained; finite brute-force checks are corroboration, not proof of arbitrarily large parameters. Published source findings and the earlier k=3 case are credited.
scientific_limitations: Exact sharp maximum and equality count proven only for q >= k >= 4 and n >= k, single non-wrapping window; not a coding-rate guarantee. Possible unindexed prior all-k coverage is a residual risk.
title: Sharp output-sphere bound and rigidity for nonbinary permutation bursts of arbitrary length
